Coerce a TSN result to a data frame

Source: R/object.R
as.data.frame.tsn.Rd

Coerce a TSN result to a data frame

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tsn'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("edges", "series"),
  connected = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A tsn result.

row.names

Optional row names.

optional

Ignored.

what

Which table to return: "edges" (the stable dyad schema, the default) or "series" (the tidy source time series, including the discretized state column when the network uses states).

connected

Return only the retained edges? The edge table lists every evaluated dyad; TRUE keeps the rows whose connected flag is set, i.e. the edges that survived the connect rule. Ignored when what = "series".

...

Ignored.

Value

A base data frame: the stable TSN dyad schema when what = "edges", or the source time series when what = "series".
